QuestInfo.name: Cracked Rubble
QuestInfo.1: Dr. Bruce needs 5 Cracked Stone Golem Rubbles for his research.\r\n
QuestInfo.2: You collected 5 Cracked Stone Golem Rubbles for Bruce's research.\r\n
QuestInfo.0: Help Bruce with his research. He's at the Golem's Temple Entrance, east of Windflower Forest.\r\n

0.0: I've uncovered some very interesting data on the artifacts at the Golem's Temple in #m100000000#, but I really need a hand with all those monsters. Would you be interested in working as my assistant? I don't like to brag, but I pay pretty darn well.\r\n
0.1: I need samples for my research. Please collect 5 Cracked Stone Golem Rubbles from the Golem's Temple for me.\r\n

yes.0: Be pickier next time! You can't just grab random rocks and expect them to produce breakthroughs. Sentience does not necessarily mean quality!

no.0: It's really not that hard and it'll look great on your resume! You care about that, right? I can even write some recommendation letters! Dr. Winston and Dr. Betty are both very close colleagues of mine. Why don't you say yes? You should say yes.

1.0: Ah, you've brought back some more usable items! Well done. See? If you exercise a little bit of professionalism, you get great results! No time to waste, hand them over!\r\n

yes.0: Oh! Look at this! There's something inside this piece! This is much better. Well done, assistant. Go out for a lunch break, but don't stray too far. We've got science to do!

item.0: You're going to need to be pretty picky about which pieces of rubble you bring back next time. I'll need 5 good pieces to make any kind of breakthroughs.\r\n
